data.title: The Ramanujan Chime
data.description: Interactive 3D spatial-synth and IEEE-754 float32 mathematics laboratory built on a constant hollow sphere V = 4/3π(R³ − r³) with an internal 2D f(x)/x slice, conjugate/antipodal phasor twins, the Four-Bit Orbit (1000 ↔ 0001 palindrome + Quadray tetrahedron), Ramanujan 1914 1/π, the discrete cyclic order-N strobe, and secp256k1 Frobenius point counting. Agents can analyze patches, inspect float32 bits, build reproducible deeplinks, and drive the live UI through the page bridge or the headless CLI/MCP server.

tools.name: manifest
tools.title: Tool manifest
tools.description: Return the capability manifest: tools, argument schemas, deeplink grammar, UI selectors, invariants, preset catalog and related local tools. Call this first to discover the toolset.

tools.name: build_deeplink
tools.title: Build a reproducible UI deeplink
tools.description: Build the canonical deeplink for a patch/view state. Params are delta-encoded against the preset base state in a fixed order; reloading the URL reproduces the view (the screenshot contract). Returns {url, query}.

preset.description: Base preset index (see manifest.catalog.presets). Default 12 (Four-Bit Orbit).

formulas.description: Formula overrides x(t), y(t), z(t); whitelisted names (sin, cos, weierstrass, morlet, …).

inputSchema.description: All args are optional; defaults reproduce the default Four-Bit Orbit view.

examples.note: Analytic Morlet patch on the harmonics tab.
Frozen Four-Bit Orbit frame at θ = 90°.

tools.name: analyze_patch
tools.title: Analyze a patch through the float32 engine
tools.description: Sample a preset (optionally with formula/parameter overrides) through the one float32 Engine.sample and report what the instrument renders: validity, float32 extents, sphere-zone histogram, hollow-shell volumes V=4/3π(R³−r³), and five probe points. No pixels, deterministic.

preset.description: Base preset index (see manifest.catalog.presets). Default 12 (Four-Bit Orbit).

formulas.description: Formula overrides x(t), y(t), z(t); whitelisted names (sin, cos, weierstrass, morlet, …).

inputSchema.description: All args optional; default preset 12 at 3200 samples.

tools.name: eval_point
tools.title: Evaluate the curve at one parameter t
tools.description: Evaluate the resolved patch at t∈[0,1] at float32 precision. Returns the point, its IEEE-754 bit patterns, the antipodal/conjugate/real-trace twins, and the same telemetry strings the UI strip shows (zone, |P|, angle).

preset.description: Base preset index (see manifest.catalog.presets). Default 12 (Four-Bit Orbit).

formulas.description: Formula overrides x(t), y(t), z(t); whitelisted names (sin, cos, weierstrass, morlet, …).

examples.note: TANGENT sentinel explosion, top of the chart.

tools.name: bit_inspect
tools.title: Inspect IEEE-754 float32 bits
tools.description: Show the exact 32-bit float32 encoding: hex, 32-char binary, sign/exponent/mantissa fields, exponent description and finite/NaN/±∞ kind. Use value for finite numbers or special for sentinels. π is 0x40490FDB.

special.description: Sentinel instead of a numeric value

inputSchema.description: Provide exactly one of value or special.

tools.name: discrete_group
tools.title: Discrete cyclic order-N strobe structure
tools.description: Compute the cyclic subgroup walked by generator stride g modulo N: gcd, subgroup order N/gcd, primality and the visited-orbit indices. Prime N (cofactor 1) visits all N states; composite N collapses to a smaller subgroup.

tools.name: ramanujan_pi
tools.title: Ramanujan 1/π series vs float32 π
tools.description: Run Ramanujan's 1914 1/π series and the Gregory–Leibniz Fourier series side by side against float32 π (0x40490FDB). Reports each term's float32 hex, whether it locks all 32 bits of π, and the dB error.

tools.name: fourbit_orbit
tools.title: Four-Bit Orbit / Quadray state at playhead θ
tools.description: Evaluate the signature Four-Bit Orbit: the meridian (XY) and equatorial (XZ) 1000(8) ↔ 0001(1) palindrome pairs, the shared ±X real projection, the inscribed Quadray tetrahedron basis and the 4-bit nibble mapped from elevation (0000 … 1111/F).

tools.name: frobenius_secp
tools.title: Frobenius trace & secp256k1 point counts
tools.description: Exact 256-bit BigInt Lucas recurrence S_k = λ^k + λ̄^k on the real secp256k1 curve and the finite-field point count #E(F_p^k) = p^k + 1 − S_k, plus the Hasse-circle angle φ. Integers are decimal strings (JSON-safe).

examples.note: S_1 = trace of Frobenius; #E(F_p) = p + 1 − S_1.

presets.name: Great Circle — 90° Quadrature Carrier
presets.note: Cosine + Sine in 90° quadrature: x²+y²=R² traces the exact equatorial slice of the sphere. Compare Antipodal (−P, null flip) vs Conjugate (P̄, collapsing to real 2·cos on X).

presets.name: Hollow Shell Carrier — 3D Radial Wavetable (R³ − r³)
presets.note: A 3D spherical wavetable whose radius breathes sinusoidally between inner cavity r and outer carrier R — living strictly inside the hollow shell V = 4/3·π(R³ − r³).

presets.name: Weierstrass Fractal — Internal 2D f(x) Slice
presets.note: W(x) = Σ aᵏ·cos(bᵏπx) plotted on the sphere's internal f(x)/x grid! Drag Harmonics K from 0 (pure cosine) to 14 (continuous everywhere, differentiable nowhere) and inspect the Zoom Lens.

presets.name: Weierstrass Curve y² = x³ + 7 — secp256k1 2D Slice
presets.note: Short Weierstrass cubic y² = x³ + 7 (secp256k1's real locus) on the 2D slice! Conjugate Twin P̄ = (x, −y) is literal elliptic-curve point negation P + (−P) = O along the vertical chord.

presets.name: Morlet Wavelet Ψ(x) — 2D Gabor Slice (§4.2)
presets.note: Real Morlet atom Ψ(x) = cos(ω₀x + φ)·e^(−x²/2) on the 2D f(x) grid. Sweep the Phase slider to watch the sine carrier glide through the stationary Gaussian window.

presets.name: Analytic Morlet ψ(t) — 3D Conjugate Helix (§4.4)
presets.note: Complex analytic Morlet ψ(t) spiraling along Z. With Conjugate Twin (P̄) active, the counter-rotating helix cancels its imaginary Y part so (ψ + ψ̄)/2 collapses into the real Morlet wave!

presets.name: Fourier Square Wave — Odd Harmonics K
presets.note: Additive synthesis of odd sine harmonics 1/(2k+1). Slide K from 0 (fundamental sine) up to 14 to sculpt a square wave and zoom into the Gibbs ringing ears.

presets.name: Ellipse — Sub-Carrier Inside Shell
presets.note: Unequal quadrature amplitudes trace an ellipse oscillating between the inner cavity r and outer shell R — watch the zone readout alternate between Shell and Cavity.

presets.name: Lissajous 3D Harmonic Knot (n : m : k)
presets.note: Integer musical frequency ratios n:m:k weave a closed 3D harmonic knot through the sphere, poking outside R (coral) at simultaneous peaks.

presets.name: Finite Field Torus Knot — Order N Cavity
presets.note: Modulo wrapping glues a 2D finite field into a 3D Torus nested strictly inside the red N-cavity (|P| < r). Order N Strobe quantizes it into N cyclic generator steps (try prime N=19 vs composite N=12)!

presets.name: Sawtooth Wrap — Finite Modulo (±1)
presets.note: saw() wraps cleanly at ±1 via modulo — a finite phase reset with zero division-by-zero, just like a hardware/VST wavetable accumulator.

presets.name: TANGENT — The #DIV/0! Sentinel Explosion
presets.note: tan() explodes past the sphere toward ±∞ at vertical asymptotes, whereas pure quadrature sphere geometry stays bounded forever.

presets.name: Four-Bit Orbit — 1000 (8) ↔ 0001 (1) Palindrome & Quadray
presets.note: Four-Bit Orbit: 1000 (8) and 0001 (1) binary palindrome duality! In Front f(x) view, 8 and 1 orbit in harmony across the sphere; in Top XZ view, 1111/F (max nibble 15) crowns the center (0000 at bottom) while the 8 ↔ 1 equatorial orbit continues around the inscribed Quadray Tetrahedron.

presets.name: Custom Formula Patch
presets.note: Free modular patch bay — write any x(t), y(t), z(t) expression using u, r, rIn, K, a, b, weierstrass, morlet, fourierSquare, sin, cos, etc.

invariants: js/engine.js is the only implementation of the float32 maths
js/agent-core.js is the only implementation of tools, envelopes and deeplinks
output is deterministic: no timestamps, randomness or locale formatting
pure tools never mutate the UI; only bridge setters change what the user sees
the URL is the UI state: a deeplink reloads to the same view (static mode is pixel-stable)
the agent layer is additive: maths, rendering and default UX are unchanged
